name: Kurotani Rio
source:
"Older Twin Sister"

She’s an energetic, athletic type who’s on the basketball team. She’s usually competitive, but perhaps because her mother works at Natsume’s father’s company, she seems unable to stand up to her. 

She has a twin sister whom she’s always cherishes. Her sister has always been frail and she protects her no matter what. It seems her father is absent.

She puts on a tough front no matter what, but she also has a surprisingly timid side.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/dmc/cha/cha03.html]official site[/url]]
